name: Regenerate
description:
Way of the Spore

Casting time: 1 minute.

You touch a creature and transfer some of your symbiotes to it, stimulating its natural healing. The creature regains 4d8+HEART Endurance.

For the next hour, the symbiotes continue to mend the creature’s body. It regains 1 Endurance at the start of each of its turns, or 12 Endurance per minute outside of combat.

Any severed digits or limbs regrow over the course of the hour. If you possess the severed part and hold it in place while casting this spell, it reattaches instantly.
